original_ai_output.title_zh: 苏丹与埃及边境金矿营地遭空袭，据称至少72名淘金者死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据总部位于喀土穆的权益组织“紧急律师”称，苏丹尼罗河州一处手工采金营地周六遭空袭，至少72名平民死亡，死亡人数为初步统计且可能上升。埃及政府和苏丹实际当局均未就此作出回应。该组织称此次袭击可能构成战争罪，并提及开罗此前曾被指对淘金者发动致命打击。

location.raw_text: a popular gold mining sites in Sudan's River Nile state

key_facts.fact: 据权益组织“紧急律师”称，苏丹尼罗河州一处手工采金营地遭空袭，至少72名平民死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least 72 civilians who had been prospecting for gold in a border region of Sudan have been killed in air strikes, a regional rights group says.

key_facts.fact: 埃及政府和苏丹实际当局迄今均未就此次袭击作出回应
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Neither the Egyptian government nor the de facto Sudanese authorities have so far commented.

key_facts.fact: 该组织称死亡人数为初步统计，可能上升
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It noted that its death toll was provisional and could rise.

key_facts.fact: 目击者称袭击于当地时间约06:00开始，飞机向矿工营地发射超过五枚导弹
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Eyewitnesses said the attack began around 06:00 local time (04:00 GMT), with the aircraft firing more than five missiles directly at the miners' camps

key_facts.fact: 开罗此前曾被指对淘金者发动致命打击，作为打击南部边境非法活动的一部分
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Cairo has previously faced accusations of deadly strikes on gold prospectors as part of a crackdown on illicit activity along its southern border.

uncertainties: 袭击责任方尚未确认，埃及与苏丹当局均未回应
死亡人数为初步统计，可能上升

此前针对淘金者的袭击属被指行为，未获证实
